entries.title: Proverbs 20:1
segments: Wine [is] a mocker, strong drink [is] raging, and whoever goes astray by it [is] not wise.

entries.title: Proverbs 20:2
segments: The fear of a king [is] as the roaring of a lion; whoever stirs him up to anger sins against his own soul.

entries.title: Proverbs 20:3
segments: [It is] an honor for a man to cease from strife, but every fool exposes himself.

entries.title: Proverbs 20:4
segments: The lazy one will not plow; after the autumn he shall beg in harvest and have nothing.

entries.title: Proverbs 20:5
segments: Wisdom in the heart of man [is like] deep water, but a man of understanding will draw it out.

entries.title: Proverbs 20:6
segments: Most men will proclaim each his own goodness, but a faithful man who can find?

entries.title: Proverbs 20:7
segments: The just walks in his integrity; his sons [are] blessed after him.

entries.title: Proverbs 20:8
segments: A king who sits in the throne of judgment scatters away all evil with his eyes.

entries.title: Proverbs 20:9
segments: Who can say, I have made my heart clean; I am pure from my sin?

entries.title: Proverbs 20:10
segments: Different kinds of weights, different kinds of measures, both [are] hateful to the LORD.

entries.title: Proverbs 20:11
segments: Even a child is known by his own doings, whether his work [is] pure and whether [it is] right.

entries.title: Proverbs 20:12
segments: The hearing ear and the seeing eye, the LORD has made both of them.

entries.title: Proverbs 20:13
segments: Do not love sleep, lest you come to poverty; open your eyes and you shall be satisfied with bread.

entries.title: Proverbs 20:14
segments: [It is] bad! Bad, says the buyer; but when [it is] left to him, then he boasts.

entries.title: Proverbs 20:15
segments: There is gold and a multitude of rubies; but the lips of knowledge [are] a rare jewel.

entries.title: Proverbs 20:16
segments: Take the garment of him who is surety [for] a stranger; and take a pledge from him for strangers.

entries.title: Proverbs 20:17
segments: Bread of deceit [is] sweet to a man, but afterwards his mouth shall be filled with gravel.

entries.title: Proverbs 20:18
segments: Purposes are established by counsel; and with good advice make war.

entries.title: Proverbs 20:19
segments: A gossip is a revealer of secrets; so do not mix with him who flatters with his lips.

entries.title: Proverbs 20:20
segments: Whoever curses his father or his mother, his lamp shall be put out in deep darkness.

entries.title: Proverbs 20:21
segments: An inheritance gotten hastily in the beginning, even the end of it shall not be blessed.

entries.title: Proverbs 20:22
segments: Do not say, I will repay evil; wait on the LORD, and He will save you.

entries.title: Proverbs 20:23
segments: Different kinds of weights [are] hateful to the LORD, and a false balance [is] not good.

entries.title: Proverbs 20:24
segments: Man's steps [are] of the LORD; how can a man then understand his own way?

entries.title: Proverbs 20:25
segments: [It is] a snare [to] a man to say rashly, A holy thing, and afterward vows to ask [about it].

entries.title: Proverbs 20:26
segments: A wise king scatters the wicked and brings the wheel over them.

entries.title: Proverbs 20:27
segments: The spirit of man [is] the lamp of the LORD, searching all the inward parts of the belly.

entries.title: Proverbs 20:28
segments: Mercy and truth preserve the king; and his throne is upheld by mercy.

entries.title: Proverbs 20:29
segments: The glory of young men [is] their strength; and the beauty of old men [is] the gray head.

entries.title: Proverbs 20:30
segments: The stripes of a wound cleanses away evil, and strokes the inward parts of the belly.
